verses.t: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
verses.pickthall: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
verses.yusufAli: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
verses.rodwell: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful
verses.sale: In the name of the most merciful God

verses.t: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds
verses.yusufAli: Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds
verses.rodwell: PRAISE be to God, Lord of the worlds
verses.sale: Praise be to God, the Lord of all creatures

verses.t: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: Master of the Day of Judgment
verses.yusufAli: Master of the Day of Judgment
verses.rodwell: King on the day of reckoning
verses.sale: the king of the day of judgment

verses.t: It is You we worship and You we ask for help
verses.pickthall: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help
verses.yusufAli: Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek
verses.rodwell: Thee only do we worship, and to Thee do we cry for help
verses.sale: Thee do we worship, and of Thee do we beg assistance

verses.t: Guide us to the straight path
verses.rodwell: Guide Thou us on the straight path
verses.sale: Direct us in the right way

verses.t: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray
verses.pickthall: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray
verses.yusufAli: The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose (portion) is not wrath, and who go not astray
verses.rodwell: The path of those to whom Thou hast been gracious; - with whom thou art not angry, and who go not astray
verses.sale: in the way of those to whom Thou hast been gracious; not of those against whom Thou art incensed, nor of those who go astray
